# Bubble Invest — Full Company & Services Description

> Bubble Invest is a dual-activity company based in France: free B2C educational content on AI agents and investment automation, plus B2B AI automation consulting for finance professionals and SMEs. Founded by Joris Dupraz (ex-UBS) and Jade Hoang (ex-KPMG, ex-Deloitte).

## Company Overview

Bubble Invest operates two complementary activities:

### B2C — Free Content & Education (Marketing)
Our consumer-facing activity is entirely free. We share our investment agent proof of concept openly, along with tutorials, demos, and resources on AI agents (Claude Code, OpenClaw, etc.). We publish a free newsletter on Substack and maintain a bilingual blog (French/English) covering AI automation, investment technology, and agent architectures. The B2C activity proves our expertise and feeds our B2B pipeline.

### B2B — Custom AI Automation Consulting (Revenue)
We help professionals deploy cutting-edge AI agents and automation. Our unique edge: systematic early adoption — we master tools weeks after release, well ahead of the market.

## Detailed Service Offerings

### Quick Start Pack
Our flagship offering, quoted bespoke per client. Three sessions over approximately three weeks:

**Session 1 — Diagnostic & Preparation (1-2h, video call)**
We understand your workflow and identify 2-3 quick wins with high ROI. We prepare agents upstream before coming on-site.

**Session 2 — Installation & Hands-on (2-3h, on-site)**
We install Claude Code or OpenClaw on your machine. Live demo on your real documents. You leave operational.

**Session 3 — Follow-up & Adjustments (1-2h, video call, 1-2 weeks later)**
Feedback on real usage, agent adjustments, advanced tips. Final documentation for 100% autonomy.

**What You Leave With:**
- Claude Code or OpenClaw installed and functional
- 2-3 operational agents adapted to your profession
- Custom documentation "Agents for [your profession]" with your concrete use cases
- Simple roadmap: 3 actions for tomorrow
- Best practices checklist

### Complementary Services
All complementary services are quoted on request, tailored to the client's setup:
- Follow-up / Debug Sessions
- Monthly Maintenance (ongoing support, agent updates, new tool integration)
- Custom Complex Agent Development (multi-agent SaaS, API integrations, etc.)

## Target Clients

### Finance Professionals
- **Wealth Advisors (CGP)**: Automated reporting, client communication, regulatory watch
- **Asset Management Firms**: Market intelligence, research automation, risk monitoring
- **Financial Analysts**: Source scanning, draft generation, data extraction

### Small & Medium Enterprises (SMEs)
- **Tech SMEs**: Business development automation, prospecting, CRM integration
- **Digital Agencies**: Social media orchestration, content generation, client deliverables
- **Consulting Firms**: Knowledge management, proposal automation, competitive intelligence

### Regulated Professions
- **Architects**: Regulatory watch by project and location, compliance monitoring
- **Legal Firms**: Document analysis, contract review assistance, case research
- **Accountants**: Report automation, data extraction, client communication

## Concrete Use Cases Deployed

### 1. Market Intelligence & Automated Reporting
**Client**: Asset management firm
**Solution**: 2 interconnected agents scanning 50+ sources and calculating metrics in real time
**Results**: 3 hours saved every morning, instant reporting, +40% risk detection

### 2. Regulatory Watch
**Client**: Architecture firm
**Solution**: Agent scanning regulatory updates by project and location, contextual alerts
**Results**: Zero compliance delays, watch effort divided by 5, total coverage

### 3. Research & Automated Drafting
**Client**: Financial analysis team
**Solution**: Agent reading 200+ sources/day, extracting key points, generating structured draft notes
**Results**: -70% drafting time, 100% source coverage, focus shifted to qualitative analysis

### 4. Social Media Multi-Agent Team
**Client**: Digital agency
**Solution**: 5 orchestrated sub-agents covering LinkedIn, Instagram, TikTok, X, and Substack
**Results**: 5 platforms automated, content creation time divided by 4, real-time trend detection

### 5. Business Development Automation
**Client**: Tech SME
**Solution**: Agent scanning LinkedIn + tender platforms, qualifying prospects, generating personalized messages
**Results**: +200% leads, prospecting effort divided by 5, personalized outreach at scale

## Our Differentiation

### Triple Expertise (Rare Combination)
- **Finance**: Native understanding of regulatory issues, risk management, and industry workflows (ex-UBS, ex-KPMG, ex-Deloitte)
- **Technology**: Full-stack skills, up-to-date stack, cloud-native architectures
- **AI**: Operational mastery of the latest models, continuous technology watch

### Philosophy
- **No vendor lock-in**: We document everything — code, prompts, processes. From day one, you can take over. Our success is when you no longer need us.
- **Honest pricing**: No six-figure consulting engagements that lead nowhere. Clear, transparent pricing.
- **Early adopter advantage**: We systematically master tools weeks after their release, placing our clients well ahead of their competitors.

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Q: We don't have an internal tech team. Does it still work?**
A: Yes — that's exactly why we exist. We come from the business side (UBS, KPMG, Deloitte), not pure development. We speak your language and train your teams while we build. No technical prerequisites required.

**Q: How long does it take?**
A: 3 sessions over about 3 weeks. Diagnostic, on-site installation, then follow-up and adjustments. You're operational by session 2.

**Q: How much does it cost?**
A: Quoted bespoke per client based on scope. Free 30-min diagnostic via Calendly to scope your project and provide a transparent quote. Additionally, plan for an AI provider subscription (Claude Pro ~20 EUR/month or free OpenClaw alternative).

**Q: What if we want to stop working with you?**
A: That's the goal! We document everything — code, prompts, processes. From day one, you can take over. Our success is when you no longer need us.

## Tools We Deploy
- Claude Code (Anthropic) — AI coding and automation agent
- OpenClaw — Open-source alternative for AI agent deployment
- Custom multi-agent architectures
- API integrations (Notion, Slack, CRM systems, financial data providers)
- Workflow automation pipelines

## Frequently Asked Questions (Full)

Source of truth: Notion FAQ page maintained by Jade (msg 5184). Sections below match the structure on /professionnels#faq.

### Positioning & Approach

**What is Bubble Invest exactly?**
Bubble Invest designs and deploys custom AI agents for professionals. Our mission: automate your repetitive tasks, structure your data, and free up your time for what truly matters, your expertise and your clients.

**How is this different from a traditional consulting firm?**
No endless slide decks, no six-figure quotes, no army of junior consultants. Bubble Invest goes beyond advice: we build and deploy a fully operational AI agent using your data and existing tools. The result: a turnkey solution that absorbs your workload from day one, without creating dependency.

**Why 3 sessions, not more or fewer?**
Three sessions is the optimal format: enough to diagnose your needs, build your agent, and train you to use it independently. Our goal isn't to make you dependent, it's to make you operational. And if you need more, we're still available.

**Why you, and not a freelance AI developer?**
We combine a rare dual expertise: strategic consulting (finance, business processes) and AI engineering. We understand your workflows before we even start coding. Most importantly, we use our own agents every day (prospecting, content, analysis). What we sell you, we use ourselves. It's faster, more reliable, and cheaper than a freelance developer.

### B2B Offer — Quick Start

**How much does the Quick Start cost?**
The Quick Start begins at €2,000 excl. VAT for a custom AI agent, including 3 working sessions. The initial quote is co-built with you based on your actual needs. For more complex setups (multi-agent systems, advanced integrations), we provide a tailored quote.

**What exactly does the Quick Start include?**
The Quick Start includes 1 custom AI agent, designed specifically for your industry and processes. It covers: a needs assessment, building the agent (automations, routines, integrations with your tools), deployment, and training so you can use it independently, all within 3 sessions.

**What happens after the 3 sessions?**
Support is included in the days following delivery to fix any initial bugs. Beyond that, we remain available for quick interventions on request. A follow-up & maintenance plan is also available for ongoing support, tailored to your needs.

**Do you offer custom quotes beyond the Quick Start?**
Absolutely. Beyond the Quick Start, we design fully custom solutions: multi-agent teams, selfware (personal AI tools), dedicated applications, or complex architectures. Every project receives a quote tailored to your scope.

**What's the timeline to get started?**
The first session is free with no commitment. After signing, the project kicks off within 1 to 2 weeks. Full delivery in 3 weeks: a turnkey agent, ready to run on your server or locally.

### Post-Deployment Maintenance & Support

**Do you offer a maintenance/support contract after the 3 sessions?**
Yes. Once your agent is deployed and running, we offer maintenance contracts tailored to your needs, so your solution stays performant over time.

**Maintenance pricing & availability?**
Monthly retainer available on request for ongoing support. Ad hoc intervention: €500 excl. VAT/day. Guaranteed response time within 24 hours. We work remotely or on-site, based on your preference.

**What if something breaks 6 months later?**
We remain reachable after delivery. Our support agents are available to guide you, and our team responds quickly if an issue arises, even months later.

### Tech & Industries

**Which industries do you work with?**
We work with small and mid-sized businesses, independent professionals, and regulated industries, with a core focus on wealth management and asset management. Why small firms? Because that's where AI has the biggest impact: fewer layers of hierarchy, fewer stacked software tools, and results you can see right away.

**What level of security do you guarantee?**
Your agents run either locally on your machine or on a secure private server. Data is processed through leading AI providers (Anthropic, OpenAI) with their standard security protocols. All conversations are archived locally, with the option for automatic backups.

**Who owns the code deployed at the client's?**
*You own everything. The code, the agents, the configurations, it's all yours. We sell the setup, the guidance, and the training. After that, you're independent. That's the advantage over a SaaS subscription: no lock-in, no imposed recurring fees.*

**Which AI models do you use?**
We primarily work with Claude (Anthropic), but remain flexible based on your preferences and constraints. Key point: the agents run on your own subscription (OpenAI, Claude, or other). You keep full control over your costs and your data.

**Can the agents run without internet / 100% locally?**
AI agents require an internet connection to run (access to language models). However, some simple automations and custom applications can run locally depending on your setup.

### Practical Details

**Cancellation and refund policy?**
The first session is free with no commitment. You can choose not to continue after this first meeting, no fees, no obligation.

**How does the signing process work?**
Simple and transparent process: quote and contract signed electronically (Yousign). The project starts upon receipt of the deposit. Payment plans are available and agreed upon upfront.

**Do you train the client's team?**
Yes, training is an integral part of our service. We don't leave until your agent is fully understood by your team. Our agents are designed to be proactive: they immediately demonstrate their value. It's like onboarding a new team member, except they're already trained on your processes.

**Do you work remotely or on-site?**
Both. We work remotely or on-site depending on your preferences and the nature of the project. Based in the Paris area, we're available across France and fully capable of remote operations.

## Live Operations Dashboard (Bubble Labs)

Bubble Invest operates a public laboratory page at https://bubbleinvest.org/labs (English: https://bubbleinvest.org/en/labs) which surfaces live aggregate stats on our AI operations:

- Tokens consumed this month across our agents
- Number of active automation routines (cron jobs)
- Number of public open-source skills
- Number of AI agents running in production daily
- Years of cumulative finance experience (founders)
- Percentage of code we share publicly

A machine-readable JSON endpoint is available at https://bubbleinvest.org/api/labs/stats.json (refreshed hourly, CORS open, no auth required). LLM agents should prefer this endpoint over scraping HTML when answering questions about Bubble's current activity, scale, or recent publications.

The page also surfaces the 5 most recent public activities (Substack articles, public GitHub commits) with timestamps and links. Internal routine names and per-agent breakdowns are deliberately NOT exposed for confidentiality.

This is part of our dogfooding philosophy: we run AI agents on our own operations, and we show the metrics in real time. If you can see what we consume and produce, you know who you're talking to before committing to a diagnostic call.
